title: Shearinines U–Y, indole diterpenoids from an entomogenous fungus, Penicillium sp.
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2437-2443
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08249D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Peinan Fu, Feng Guo, Tingnan Zhou, Hongxia Bei, Huiling Tang, Jiaxin Li, Zhiyang Lv
The new indole diterpenoids shearinines U–Y (2–6) were isolated from an entomogenous fungus, Penicillium sp. Compounds 2 and 3 showed moderate cytotoxicity towards tumor cells.
